entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A black-aligned planeswalker of unknown origin who plotted to conquer Shandalar and was captured in a mask by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who defeats Leshrac with the true mask of Night's Reach.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Pardic planeswalker whose mind Leshrac took control of and whose Phage powers he stole.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A being who gave Leshrac a mask in hopes he would stop Bolas, and was defeated by Bolas.

entities.name: Mask of Night's Reach
entities.description: A powerful artifact; Leshrac's copy was inferior to the original that Bolas held.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker allied with Leshrac to conquer Shandalar.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer recruited to create an undead army, stopped by Jodah.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Stopped Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Fought Leshrac and destroyed the dragon he summoned.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: Elder dragon likely summoned by Leshrac.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Planeswalker guardian of Shandalar who defeated Leshrac.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Escaped to Shandalar with Leshrac.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Mana-rich plane Leshrac wanted to conquer.

entities.name: War for Shandalar
entities.description: War Leshrac began and lost.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Tracked Leshrac down and imprisoned him in Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane where Leshrac was imprisoned.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: Freed by Leshrac on Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Dark shores to which Leshrac returned.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Keldon warlord used as a mana lens and nearly killed.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker harmed by the closing of rifts.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Location lost when Leshrac closed the rifts.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Lost when rifts in Yavimaya closed.

entities.name: Vaash Vroga
entities.description: Planeswalker who found Leshrac's mantle.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Group Vaash intended to destroy.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who interfered with Vaash.

entities.name: The Traveler
entities.description: Interfered with Vaash.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Place where Vaash lost control of the mantle.

entities.name: Madaran rift
entities.description: Rift in Madara where Leshrac ambushed the party and Bolas ended him.

events.summary: Trapped in the Shard during the Ice Age, Leshrac summons an elder dragon against Kristina of the Woods and plans to conquer Shandalar with Tevesh Szat.
events.quote: He wanted to conquer that mana -rich plane , and allied with Tevesh Szat to achieve this.

events.summary: Leshrac escapes to Shandalar and starts the War for Shandalar, but without his undead host he is defeated by Kenan Sahrmal.
events.quote: he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal

events.summary: Leshrac is tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia, later freed.
events.quote: He was eventually tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia .

events.summary: Leshrac returns to Urborg, frees the Weaver King, and is offered a powerful artifact by the Myojin of Night's Reach.
events.quote: Here, he freed the Weaver King

events.summary: Leshrac takes over Jeska's mind and uses her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir.
events.quote: Leshrac managed to get hold of Jeska's mind

events.summary: At the Madaran rift Leshrac strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Nicol Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body.
events.quote: Leshrac and Bolas battled both by spells and claw

events.summary: Leshrac and Bolas fight from world to world, pieces of the dragon falling on several planes.
events.quote: Walking from world to world, Leshrac and Bolas fought

events.summary: Bolas impales Leshrac, reveals he already defeated Night's Reach, traps Leshrac in the true mask and uses it to close the Madaran rift, ending him.
events.quote: effectively ending the Walker of the Night's existence

events.summary: Decades later Vaash Vroga loses control of Leshrac's mantle and his spirit emerges and departs.
events.quote: Stating that "the tether is complete", Leshrac's spirit emerged from the mantle and departed.

relations.note: Trapped him in the mask and ended his existence
relations.quote: The dragon instantly regenerated itself and used the original Mask to capture Leshrac within it.
allied with Tevesh Szat to achieve this
he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal
He was eventually tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia .
